tasks.label: CMake: Configure
tasks.detail: Configures the default build: matches ngen CI's test_unit job (NetCDF/UDUNITS/SQLite on, BMI-C/Python/MPI off). Falls back to /opt/boost_1_79_0 if BOOST_ROOT is unset, and fails fast with a readable message if the Boost it points at has no version.hpp. See ngen-vscode-dev-setup.md to enable the optional components.

tasks.label: Setup: Python venv (numpy<2)
tasks.detail: One-time setup for any NGEN_WITH_PYTHON=ON build: creates a container-side virtualenv at .venv-linux with numpy<2.0 (CMakeLists.txt rejects numpy>=2.0.0) and initializes the extern/pybind11 submodule. Deliberately NOT named .venv: a .venv created on a macOS host is bind-mounted into the container but its binaries cannot run there. The Python configure tasks activate this venv themselves; activate it yourself too (source .venv-linux/bin/activate) before running an ngen built with embedded Python, since CMake binds to the interpreter present at configure time.

tasks.label: CMake: Configure (Full: BMI-C + Python)
tasks.detail: Opt-in configure: also enables BMI-C (pulls in TOPMODEL/CFE/PET/LGAR extern models) and embedded Python (which turns NGEN_WITH_ROUTING on too). Activates .venv-linux itself, so run the Setup: Python venv (numpy<2) task once first; without it CMake fails with Could NOT find Python (missing: Python_NumPy_INCLUDE_DIRS NumPy).

tasks.label: CMake: Configure (BMI-C + Fortran/Noah)
tasks.detail: Opt-in configure: BMI-C plus BMI-Fortran, which also turns on Noah-OWP-Modular (NGEN_WITH_EXTERN_NOAH_OWP_MODULAR defaults ON whenever NGEN_WITH_BMI_FORTRAN is ON). Needs no setup task and no venv — gfortran is in the image and CMake clones the nested extern/noah-owp-modular submodule itself at configure time. BMI-C is ON because Noah's shipped realization configs are bmi_multi with SLoTH/PET/CFE; Python is OFF because Noah needs nothing from it. Note: the test_bmi_fortran/test_bmi_c targets do not currently compile (pre-existing forcing_params arity mismatch in the test sources), so build the ngen target with this configure, not the test suites.

tasks.label: Setup: Build Boost with serialization (UEB)
tasks.detail: One-time setup for UEB: builds and installs a compiled Boost (with the serialization component) to /opt/boost-built. The default image only has Boost headers at $BOOST_ROOT. Slow — let it finish; it verifies version.hpp landed, because an interrupted b2 install leaves early-alphabet headers behind and every later configure then fails with Found unsuitable version 0.0.0. Run this once before using the UEB configure task.

tasks.label: Setup: Build and install EWTS (UEB)
tasks.detail: One-time setup for UEB: installs the MPI dev libs (gfortran is already in the image), then builds and installs EWTS (UEB's hard find_package(ewts) dependency) to /opt/ewts. Configures from extern/ewts (the root CMakeLists.txt with the real project()/VERSION), not extern/ewts/runtime as upstream's INSTALL.md says — the runtime-only configure has no project() and fails at write_basic_package_version_file. Also passes Boost's headers via CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS since EWTS's ngen bridge includes boost/property_tree but never calls find_package(Boost) itself. Run this once before using the UEB configure task, after the Boost setup task.

tasks.label: CMake: Configure (BMI-C + UEB)
tasks.detail: Opt-in configure: BMI-C plus UEB (bmi_c++ snow model). Python is OFF because UEB needs nothing from it. Requires a compiled Boost (with serialization) installed to /opt/boost-built and EWTS installed to /opt/ewts first — both are checked up front, with a message naming the setup task to run. Also forces CMP0057=NEW and pre-supplies NETCDF_C_LIB_DIR/NETCDF_C_INCLUDE_DIR, working around two bugs in extern/ueb-bmi's own CMakeLists.txt that otherwise break NetCDF detection when NGEN_WITH_NETCDF is on.

tasks.label: CMake: Configure (Everything)
tasks.detail: Opt-in configure: every model component this image supports at once — BMI-C (SLoTH/TOPMODEL/CFE/PET/LGAR), BMI-Fortran (Noah-OWP-Modular), UEB (bmi_c++) and embedded Python (which turns routing on). Uses /opt/boost-built as BOOST_ROOT since UEB needs the compiled Boost, and that install serves the rest too. Requires all three setup tasks first (Python venv, Boost, EWTS) — each is checked up front. Not included: MPI (no runtime in the image) and SMP/SoilFreezeThaw (independent NGEN_WITH_EXTERN_SMP/SFT options, untested here). Build with: make -C commands build TARGETS="ngen bmiuebcxx surfacebmi"

tasks.label: Build ngen (CMake)
tasks.detail: Builds the ngen driver executable and the test_bmi_cpp shared library the example realization config in data/ loads. The Makefile runs the DEFAULT configure only when cmake_build/CMakeCache.txt is absent, so an opt-in configure (Fortran/Noah, Python, UEB, Everything) is never silently reverted; it prints the active options before building. For the extra model libraries of an opt-in configure, pass the targets: make -C commands build TARGETS="ngen bmiuebcxx"

tasks.label: Build test_unit (CMake)
tasks.detail: Configures (if needed) then builds the test_unit and test_geopackage suites (mirrors ngen CI's test_unit job).

tasks.label: Build test binary (CMake)
tasks.detail: Configures (if needed) then builds an arbitrary test target by name. Used as the preLaunchTask for the generic 'Debug a test binary' launch config — see ngen-vscode-dev-setup.md.

tasks.label: Clean ngen
tasks.detail: Removes the cmake_build directory entirely. Also the fix when a configure task picks up stale cached paths from a different configure task — they all share one cmake_build.

tasks.label: Setup: Build CFE shared library
tasks.detail: Builds extern/cfe as its own CMake project into extern/cfe/cmake_build, producing libcfebmi.so and cfebmi.pc. Needed before installing the Python CFE BMI wrapper, which is a C extension that links that library at build time. Independent of the ngen build in cmake_build.

tasks.label: Setup: Build Noah-OWP-Modular shared library
tasks.detail: Reconfigures the same cmake_build every configure task uses, with the Fortran configure's flags, then builds only the surfacebmi target -- there is no isolated build dir to use instead, since extern/noah-owp-modular's own CMakeLists always places its build output at a fixed path under extern/ regardless of which top build dir triggered the configure. If cmake_build was configured differently (e.g. the Python configure), this reverts it to the Fortran flags, same as running any other configure task would; run Clean ngen first for a from-scratch reconfigure. Needed because extern/noah-owp-modular's own CMakeLists only links iso_c_bmi and skips NetCDF inside the NGEN_IS_MAIN_PROJECT branch -- a standalone configure of that subdirectory alone hits the broken else-branch instead. Produces extern/noah-owp-modular/cmake_build/libsurfacebmi.so, needed before installing the Python Noah BMI wrapper, which is a Fortran extension that links that library at build time.

tasks.label: Setup: Install BMI Python wrappers
tasks.detail: pip installs each Python BMI wrapper package from tools/bmi-wrappers/requirements.txt into .venv-linux individually, gated on its own shared library already being built -- a missing Noah lib only skips Noah's wrapper (with a note on what to run first) rather than blocking CFE's install too, and vice versa. Exports the CFE_ROOT/CFE_LIB_DIR that pymt_cfe's setup.py needs and the NOAH_ROOT/NOAH_LIB_DIR/NOAH_MOD_DIR that pymt_noah_owp's setup.py needs. Run the Setup: Python venv task first, plus whichever of Setup: Build CFE shared library / Setup: Build Noah-OWP-Modular shared library correspond to the wrapper(s) you want. These wrappers are introspection helpers only -- ngen still runs these models through its own BMI adapters, and nothing here is imported by the ngen binary.

tasks.label: BMI: Show model input/output requirements
tasks.detail: Queries the chosen model live for its BMI inputs and outputs with units, types, and grids, using the sample config registered for it in tools/bmi-wrappers/wrappers.json. To also cross-check an ngen realization config, run it from a terminal instead: make -C commands bmi-io MODEL=cfe|noah CONFIG=... REALIZATION=...

tasks.label: Rebuild ngen
tasks.detail: Clean, then a full fresh configure + build.

inputs.description: CMake target name to build, which is also the resulting test binary name under cmake_build/test/ (see test/CMakeLists.txt for the full list, e.g. test_partition, test_nexus, test_geojson, test_mdarray, test_logging). Must match what you enter for the launch config's own prompt.
Which model's BMI wrapper to query (key from tools/bmi-wrappers/wrappers.json)
